title: Cloud City: Network Security: VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor & Firewalls

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Smugglers were sneaking contraband through unregulated river docks and loading municipal wagons to ship city secrets outside the gates.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Warden Ward erected fortified perimeter walls (VPC Service Controls) and customs inspection checkpoints (Cloud Armor).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a rogue merchant attempted to take municipal gold bars through the east gate, automated weight sensors locked the turnstile.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: City stone gates take days to rebuild; cloud perimeter policies update globally across Google's edge network in seconds.
